name: Kindness
overview: Scripture reveals kindness as a gracious and compassionate response toward others, demonstrated by Pharaoh’s favorable treatment of Joseph’s family and Pharaoh’s invitation for them to dwell in the best land (Genesis 45:16; 47:5-6). The kindness of Pharaoh’s daughter toward the infant Moses, moved by compassion, exemplifies tender care for the vulnerable (Exodus 2:6). God commands His people to love the stranger as themselves, reflecting a divine standard for kindness rooted in shared experience (Leviticus 19:34), and instructs them to actively restore what belongs to their neighbor, showing practical kindness in daily life (Deuteronomy 22:1). Together, these verses emphasize kindness as both a heartfelt attitude and tangible action toward others within the community.
